revenueByPlatform.note: Full refresh 2026-08-15. UberEats/Lieferando/Wolt cumulative totals rolled forward using the weekly periods already added to uber_eats.json/lieferando.json/wolt.json since the 27.07 baseline (no date overlap, so simple addition). APPROXIMATION FLAGGED: gross/net/vat7 deltas for these three platforms were derived from each period's netAfterDiscounts or revenue_gross figure grossed up at 7% VAT, matching the pattern in the original baseline (gross ≈ net × 1.07) — not a line-by-line reconciliation like the SumUp refresh. platformFees deltas sum each period's total fee/commission line. Wolt order counts are not tracked at the weekly level, so Wolt orderCount is unchanged (understated for this period) — flagged, not corrected. Tollwood has no newer data — the tracked event (summer 2026) has concluded; next data expected for winter Tollwood. SumUp Restaurant/Foodtruck are the only channels refreshed with full day-level fidelity (01.07-14.08.2026, no gaps).
